# zendesk_custom_role (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Custom Agent Role to be used in your Zendesk instance. Requires the Enterprise plan or above.
# For details see https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/account-configuration/custom_roles/
# Following example creates a custom role for partners, who can only make private comments on assigned tickets.
# All configuration attributes are optional. Attributes not set are left to the Zendesk defaults.
resource "zendesk_custom_role" "partner" {
  custom_role = {
    # Name of the custom role
    name = "Partner"
    # Description of the custom role
    description = "Can only make private comments on assigned tickets"
    configuration = {
      # What kind of tickets the agent can access: all, assigned-only, within-groups, within-groups-and-public-groups, within-organization
      ticket_access = "assigned-only"
      # What type of comments the agent can make: public, none
      ticket_comment_access = "none"
      # What the agent can do with end-user profiles: edit, edit-within-org, full, readonly
      end_user_profile_access = "readonly"
      # What the agent can do with views: full, manage-group, manage-personal, playonly, readonly
      view_access = "playonly"
      # What the agent can do with macros: full, manage-group, manage-personal, readonly
      macro_access    = "readonly"
      ticket_editing  = true
      ticket_deletion = false
      # Permissions (scopes) for custom objects: read, update, delete, create
      custom_objects = {
        shipment = {
          scopes = ["read"]
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `custom_role` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_role))

### Optional

- `custom_role_id` (Number) The ID of the custom agent role

<a id="nestedatt--custom_role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_role`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the custom role

Optional:

- `configuration` (Attributes) Configuration settings for the role. See [Configuration](#configuration) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_role--configuration))
- `description` (String) A description of the role

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The time the record was created
- `id` (Number) Automatically assigned on creation
- `role_type` (Number) The user's role. 0 stands for a custom agent, 1 for a light agent, 2 for a chat agent, 3 for a contributor, 4 for an admin and 5 for a billing admin. See [Understanding standard agent roles in Zendesk Support](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4409155971354-Understanding-standard-agent-roles-in-Zendesk-Support) in Zendesk help
- `team_member_count` (Number) The number of team members assigned to this role
- `updated_at` (String) The time the record was last updated

### Nested Schema for `custom_role.configuration`

Optional:

- `actions_access` (String) What level of actions access the agent has. Allowed values: "none", "workflows_and_zendesk", "all"

- `custom_objects` (Attributes Map) A list of custom object keys mapped to JSON objects that define the agent's permissions (scopes) for each object. Allowed values: "read", "update", "delete", "create". ## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Custom Role can be imported by specifying the numeric identifier.
terraform import zendesk_custom_role.example 10127
# It can also be imported by specifying the name of the custom role.
terraform import zendesk_custom_role.example "Partner"
```
